description: Recorded synthetic regression cases. This is not the independent 40-60 article gold set required for live quality validation.

cases.title: Port Delta announces planned strike
cases.body: Port Delta authority announced a planned strike lasting 24 hours. The planned stoppage concerns cargo handling at Port Delta. An official reopening announcement has not yet been issued.
facts: Port Delta authority announced a planned strike lasting 24 hours.
followup_needs: Check official Port Delta reopening announcement

cases.title: Market A proposes repatriation rule
cases.body: Market A regulator published a proposal to change the approval process for corporate repatriation payments. The proposal has not been adopted and creates no current payment restriction.
facts: Market A regulator published a proposal to change the approval process for corporate repatriation payments.

cases.title: Market B raises policy rate
cases.body: Market B central bank announced that its policy rate increased by 50 basis points. The statement describes the size of the adjustment but does not provide a comparable previous rate level.
facts: Market B central bank announced that its policy rate increased by 50 basis points.

cases.title: MPA and CCS sign cooperation agreement
cases.body: MPA and CCS signed an agreement covering green shipping. The same agreement also covers digitization of maritime services. The notice provides no numerical targets or binding payment obligations.
facts: MPA and CCS signed an agreement covering green shipping.
The same agreement also covers digitization of maritime services.

cases.title: Port Delta kündigt Streik an
cases.body: Translated from Port Delta statement. Die Hafenbehörde Port Delta kündigte einen geplanten Streik von 24 hours an. Diese übersetzte Meldung ist eine syndizierte Kopie der ursprünglichen Ankündigung.
facts: Port Delta authority announced a planned strike lasting 24 hours.

cases.title: Port Delta strike extended
cases.body: Independent port reporting confirms that the planned strike at Port Delta was extended from 24 hours to 72 hours. Both durations refer to the same planned cargo-handling stoppage at Port Delta.
facts: The planned strike at Port Delta was extended from 24 hours to 72 hours.

cases.title: Customs introduces clearance documentation rule
cases.body: The customs authority adopted a new requirement for electronic clearance documents. The notice specifies the documents that must accompany submissions but states no numerical settlement limit.
facts: The customs authority adopted a new requirement for electronic clearance documents.

cases.title: Unofficial post alleges strike ended
cases.body: An unofficial social-media post alleges that the Port Delta strike has ended. The claim has not been verified by the port authority or independent reporting and remains an unconfirmed allegation.
facts: An unverified unofficial post alleges that the Port Delta strike has ended.
followup_needs: Check official Port Delta reopening announcement

cases.title: Port Delta authority confirms reopening
cases.body: Port Delta authority confirmed in an official operational notice that cargo handling has resumed. This reopening notice is a separate publication from the original planned strike announcement.
facts: Port Delta authority confirmed that cargo handling has resumed.

cases.title: Port Delta strike extended
cases.body: Independent port reporting confirms that the planned strike at Port Delta was extended from 24 hours to 72 hours. Both durations refer to the same planned cargo-handling stoppage at Port Delta. Update: the port authority has now confirmed that cargo handling has resumed.
facts: The planned strike at Port Delta was extended from 24 hours to 72 hours.
The port authority has now confirmed that cargo handling has resumed.

cases.title: Port Delta strike extended
cases.body:
Independent port reporting confirms that the planned strike at Port Delta was extended from 24 hours to 72 hours.

Both durations refer to the same planned cargo-handling stoppage at Port Delta.  Update: the port authority has now confirmed that cargo handling has resumed.
facts: The planned strike at Port Delta was extended from 24 hours to 72 hours.
The port authority has now confirmed that cargo handling has resumed.

cases.title: Fuel and freight observations
cases.body: The shipping bulletin reported bunker fuel at 600 USD per tonne. It also reported a freight rate of 1200 USD per TEU. The bulletin supplies no comparable earlier observations for either measure.
facts: The shipping bulletin reported bunker fuel at 600 USD per tonne.
It also reported a freight rate of 1200 USD per TEU.

cases.title: Port congestion worsens
cases.body: The port operator reported that congestion is worsening. The public notice provides no numerical waiting-time estimate and does not estimate how many company shipments may be affected.
facts: The port operator reported that congestion is worsening.

cases.title: Inflation measure rises
cases.body: The statistics office reported annual inflation at 4 percent, compared with 3 percent in the previous month. Both figures use the same national consumer-price index definition and annual reference basis.
facts: Annual inflation was 4 percent, compared with 3 percent in the previous month.

cases.title: Market A proposes repatriation rule
cases.body: Correction: Market A regulator clarified that the repatriation-payment approval change remains a proposal. The proposal has not been adopted. An earlier description suggesting that the rule was already in force was incorrect.
facts: Market A regulator clarified that the repatriation-payment approval change remains a proposal.
The proposal has not been adopted.
